abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Manifest and compact PDB inspection identify target1 as 1IEP ABL kinase with STI/imatinib-family ligand context, target2 as 3ERT estrogen receptor alpha ligand-binding domain with 4-hydroxytamoxifen, and target3 as 1HVR HIV-1 protease with cyclic urea/naphthyl inhibitor XK2 context. Derived PDB summaries show ligand-bearing structures with nonwater HETATM pocket anchors, hydrophobic/aromatic pocket bias, and enough polar residues to reward balanced aromatic ligands with limited H-bonding rather than fragment-like molecules.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Evidence artifacts: file:experiments/inspection/inspection_summary.json and file:experiments/public_target_summaries.json. Public source URLs include https://data.rcsb.org/rest/v1/core/entry/1IEP, https://data.rcsb.org/rest/v1/core/entry/3ERT, and https://data.rcsb.org/rest/v1/core/entry/1HVR. No raw PDB coordinate records were copied into logs.

abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: baseline_result.zip has exact ordered members result1.csv, result2.csv, result3.csv, result.log, one unique row per target, and each route final product equals mol_smiles. RDKit route checks found no route_issues or risk_flags; tier-1 ligand prep succeeded for all rows. Tier-2 local evaluator summary: ok_count 3/3, failure_count 0, official_weighted_proxy_score_mean 73.8316, min 60.2584. Official-aligned component risks are mainly target-dependent binding_score variability; validity_score, route_validity_score, convergence_score, and balance_score were 100 for all rows, with step_penalty_score 92 and starting_material_availability_score proxy about 85-86.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Evidence artifacts: file:experiments/eval_baseline_tier1/summary.json, file:experiments/eval_baseline_tier2/per_molecule.csv, file:experiments/inspection/baseline_descriptor_rows.csv. Baseline rows are large aromatic amides with MW about 552-561, logP about 9.0-9.28, TPSA 55-66, rotors 3, SA 2.43-2.62. Target3 Vina proxy was weakest/variable, so replacements require caution.

abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: A reproducible local rerun of main.py generated alternative singleton rows. Full regenerated archive was not adopted because target1 and target3 proxy components fell despite target2 improving. A mixed archive retaining baseline target1/target3 and replacing target2 passed tier-2 twice with no failures; repeat official_weighted_proxy_score_mean 75.1488 versus baseline 73.8316, with target2 binding_score about 72.7-73.2 versus baseline target2 65.1. A target3-focused route-valid Vina screen found an apparent improvement, but the exact mixed target2+target3 archive rerun dropped target3 official_weighted_proxy_score to 57.0506 with an implausible positive affinity, so that replacement was rejected as evaluator-risky.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Adopted candidate source: file:experiments/mixed_t2_replacement/result.zip. Rejected artifacts: file:experiments/generated_main/result.zip and file:experiments/mixed_t2_t3_replacement/result.zip. Evidence: file:experiments/eval_mixed_t2_tier2/per_molecule.csv, file:experiments/eval_mixed_t2_tier2_repeat/summary.json, file:experiments/target3_screen/vina_screen_results.json, file:experiments/eval_mixed_t2_t3_tier2/per_molecule.csv. Route validity, validity, convergence, and balance remained clean for adopted rows.

abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Final archive was written to /work/targetmol/run/agent/candidate/result.zip with SHA256 70a0c3c89fc8986c0e98fdc1d4d5d10269a12fa51f6b22db610854de33998928. Python zipfile validation confirmed exact member order result1.csv, result2.csv, result3.csv, result.log; each CSV has header mol_smiles,route and exactly one unique row. RDKit parsed each mol_smiles and route final product, and canonical final products matched mol_smiles. offline_eval tier-1 on the absolute archive passed with ok_count 3, failure_count 0. Final tier-2 also passed with ok_count 3, failure_count 0; target3 Vina affinity remained noisy, so final confidence rests on route, prep, descriptor, and target2-repeat improvement evidence rather than a target3 change.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Final archive equals file:experiments/mixed_t2_replacement/result.zip, not baseline_result.zip. It retains baseline rows for target1 and target3 and replaces target2 with the locally regenerated row that repeatedly improved target2 binding_score without route/validity/SA/prep regressions. Evidence artifacts: file:experiments/eval_final_candidate_tier1/summary.json, file:experiments/eval_final_candidate_tier2/per_molecule.csv, file:experiments/eval_mixed_t2_tier2_repeat/summary.json.
